:root{--bg:#ECEFF2;--surf:#FFFFFF;--ink:#18212B;--mut:#5D6B78;--line:#D5DBE1;--brass:#84601D;--blue:#2F6CD4;--red:#C9412F;--blue-t:rgba(47,108,212,.14);--red-t:rgba(201,65,47,.13);

:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#121820;--surf:#1B232D;--ink:#E6EBF0;--mut:#93A1AE;--line:#2C3743;--brass:#D9B064;--blue:#5B95F0;--red:#EC6A55;--blue-t:rgba(91,149,240,.18);--red-t:rgba(236,106,85,.16);--on-brass:#1B1405;--hi:#5FCB93;--mi:#D9B064;--lo:#EC8A78}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans KR",system-ui,"Apple SD Gothic Neo","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif}
header{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;padding:18px 20px 6px;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;flex-wrap:wrap}
header h1{font:400 34px/1 "Black Han Sans","IBM Plex Sans KR",sans-serif;margin:0;letter-spacing:.5px}
header h1 span{color:var(--brass)}
header p{margin:0;color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
nav{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:5;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
nav div{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;gap:2px;overflow-x:auto;padding:0 12px}
nav button{background:none;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;color:var(--mut);font:500 15px "IBM Plex Sans KR",sans-serif;padding:12px 10px 9px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
nav button[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--ink);border-bottom-color:var(--brass)}
main{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 16px 60px}
section{margin:0 0 22px}
h2{font:400 26px/1.2 "Black Han Sans",sans-serif;margin:0 0 4px}
h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--mut)}
h4{font-size:13px;margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--brass)}
button,select,input,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brass);outline-offset:2px}
.controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-end;background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px}
#analysis-tiers .controls{background:none;border:0;padding:0}
#analysis-tiers details{width:300px;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#analysis-tiers summary{min-height:44px;cursor:pointer}
.analysis-controls label{flex:1 1 160px}
/* Match review: one selected record, explicit evidence tabs, compact master/detail. */
.match-workspace{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf)}
.review-title{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.review-title h3,.review-title p{margin:0}
.review-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:420px}
.review-list{border-right:1px solid var(--line);min-width:0;background:var(--bg)}
.review-picker{padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.review-picker label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
.review-picker select{display:block;width:100%;max-width:100%;margin-top:5px;min-width:0}
.review-list-buttons{max-height:620px;overflow:auto}
.review-list-buttons button{display:block;text-align:left;width:100%;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0;background:transparent;padding:12px 14px;color:var(--ink)}
.review-list-buttons button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--surf);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 var(--brass)}
.review-list-buttons span,.review-list-buttons small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
.review-list-buttons strong{display:block;margin:3px 0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.review-detail{min-width:0;padding:0 16px 16px}
.review-heading{display:block;padding:16px 0;max-width:none;text-align:left}
.review-heading h3{font-family:inherit;font-size:22px;margin:5px 0;letter-spacing:0}
.review-heading p{margin:3px 0;font-size:13px}
.review-result{font-weight:600}.review-result span{font-weight:400;color:var(--mut);margin-left:12px}
.review-tabs{display:flex;gap:20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:14px}
.review-tabs button{border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--mut);padding:10px 0;font-size:13px}
.review-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{border-bottom-color:var(--brass);color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.review-detail h3,.review-detail h4,.review-title h3{font-family:inherit;letter-spacing:0}
.review-detail table{font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.review-detail td:nth-child(n+3),.review-detail th:nth-child(n+3){text-align:right}
.review-detail td,.review-detail th{padding:8px 10px}
.review-events ol{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.review-events li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:54px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px}
.review-events time{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--mut)}
.review-empty{padding:48px 20px;color:var(--mut);max-width:440px}.review-empty h4{color:var(--ink)}
@media(max-width:720px){.review-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.review-list{border-right:0}.review-list-buttons{display:none}.review-title{display:block}.review-title p{margin-top:4px}.review-detail{padding:0 10px 12px}.review-heading h3{font-size:19px}.review-result span{display:block;margin-left:0}.review-tabs{gap:18px}}

.analysis-room #opponentpreparation>label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;max-width:360px;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}
.analysis-room #pprepteam{background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);width:100%;min-width:0}
.controls label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);min-width:0}
.controls select,.controls input{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);min-width:0}
.seedrow{display:flex;gap:4px}.seedrow input{width:130px}
.primary{background:var(--brass);color:var(--on-brass);border:0;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 18px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.tactic-axis{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;color:var(--mut)}
.linklike{background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--ink);min-height:44px;padding:8px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}
.ghost{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.empty,.hint{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
